canonical_owner: MCP capability guide / source preflight / existing assurance run
minimum_source: Authorized repo+verified access or supported local bundle
positive_acceptance: Qualified source finding, action map, source limits, exact next action
negative_acceptance: No access or no source => explicit source/consent need; not PASS
design_decision: Source-only path should never require enterprise IAM, monitoring or control questionnaire
implementation_gate: Assigned developer role / current plan / source negative

canonical_owner: Deployment decision endpoint / operating envelope / persistence
transport: UI/session API; no direct mutating MCP assumption
minimum_source: Tenant-owned system; assigned reviewer; exact request digest and approved version
negative_acceptance: Cross org or unassigned reviewer or requester-as-reviewer denied; draft policy not approval
design_decision: Separate human deployment decision from policy approval, DAI and target runtime permission
implementation_gate: Positive+negative authorization and CAS stale digest

canonical_owner: OTLP receiver / binder / monitoring read model
minimum_source: Qualified system-bound source, freshness window, authenticated intake
positive_acceptance: Source status, actual received event, limitations, triage next action
negative_acceptance: Stale or missing collector ≠ no action; token trace ≠ effect
design_decision: Run monitor goal without preliminary static scan or compliance gate
implementation_gate: Actual source health and one target-bound effect witness

canonical_owner: Kill Switch trigger/recover / execution guard / guardrail persistence
transport: Privileged API/UI; no generic write MCP claim
minimum_source: Correct org, privileged operator, exact target integration / actor identity
positive_acceptance: Record control decision and prove targeted dispatch denial when integrated
negative_acceptance: Foreign org 404 without operational writes; role denied; saved KILLED ≠ physical stop
design_decision: Keep exact decision, state, enforced and effect statuses distinct
implementation_gate: Security PR 2220 CI+tenant smoke; separate applied-action receipt

canonical_owner: Control-test qualified bundle / profile + U6 packages / passport
minimum_source: Applicable executable rule, owned exact evaluation, qualified issuer/source
positive_acceptance: Evidence-backed rule outcome; CURRENT/HISTORICAL and scope traceable
negative_acceptance: REGISTER_ONLY or missing source not PASS; old package not current
design_decision: Treat competition control-test endpoint as specialized not universal
implementation_gate: One real owned evaluation / applicable control / authorized report

canonical_owner: Product surface registry / org portfolio / decision history / consequence delta
minimum_source: Owned system collection, exact current/historical evaluation and decisions
positive_acceptance: Consequence-first portfolio, coverage frontier, review queue, report deep link
negative_acceptance: No foreign org, no synthetic scene counted as actual customer operating proof
design_decision: Read-only persona presentation, no verdict or permission recalculation
implementation_gate: Org isolation and deep link / current-snapshot separation
